e.title: heavytails (Python)
e.summary: Python 重尾概率分布库：连续/离散重尾分布、尾指数估计、诊断工具，NumPy 向量化
e.body: heavytails 是从第一性原理构建的 Python 重尾分布库：实现连续与离散重尾分布族、尾指数（tail index）估计方法与诊断工具，全部基于 NumPy 向量化评估。亮点是生存函数直接计算——在深尾区域 1-CDF 已丢失全部有效数字时仍保持精度，这对再保险与巨灾风险分析至关重要。目标定位为风险/金融/保险/极值分析的研究、教学与模拟。MIT 许可，PyPI + Zenodo DOI（10.5281/zenodo.22045594）+ mkdocs 文档，工程质量高（CI/codecov/mypy/ruff）。与 R 生态的 [[pareto-r]]、[[comppareto]]、[[tailloss]]、[[mev]]、[[extremes]] 形成 Python 侧互补。
e.verified_note: GitHub API + PyPI 核实：MIT，v0.6.3（PyPI），Python>=3.10，CI/codecov/文档齐全，Zenodo DOI，topics 含 actuarial-science/extreme-value-theory
e.summary_en: Python library for heavy-tailed probability distributions: continuous/discrete heavy tails, tail index estimation, diagnostic utilities, NumPy-vectorized
e.summary_hk: Python 重尾概率分佈庫：連續/離散重尾分佈、尾指數估計、診斷工具，NumPy 向量化
e.body_en: heavytails is a Python library of heavy-tailed probability distributions built from first principles: continuous and discrete heavy-tailed families, tail index estimators and diagnostic utilities, all with NumPy-vectorized evaluation. A key feature is that survival functions are computed directly, staying accurate deep into the tail where 1-CDF has lost every significant digit — critical for reinsurance and catastrophe risk analysis. Positioned for research, teaching and simulation in risk, finance, insurance and extreme-value analysis. MIT licensed, on PyPI with a Zenodo DOI (10.5281/zenodo.22045594) and mkdocs documentation; high engineering quality (CI/codecov/mypy/ruff). Complements the R ecosystem's [[pareto-r]], [[comppareto]], [[tailloss]], [[mev]] and [[extremes]] on the Python side.
e.body_hk: heavytails 是從第一性原理構建的 Python 重尾分佈庫：實現連續與離散重尾分佈族、尾指數（tail index）估計方法與診斷工具，全部基於 NumPy 向量化評估。亮點是生存函數直接計算——在深尾區域 1-CDF 已丟失全部有效數字時仍保持精度，這對再保險與巨災風險分析至關重要。目標定位為風險/金融/保險/極值分析的研究、教學與模擬。MIT 許可，PyPI + Zenodo DOI（10.5281/zenodo.22045594）+ mkdocs 文檔，工程質量高（CI/codecov/mypy/ruff）。與 R 生態的 [[pareto-r]]、[[comppareto]]、[[tailloss]]、[[mev]]、[[extremes]] 形成 Python 側互補。
